description:

Senior Specialist - Application Security
  
  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Workplace Type: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req32551**
It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
  
  
The Senior Specialist in this position will enterprise application security SME – VAPT of Web, API, Android and iOS and manager end-to-end VAPT – planning, execution, reporting, remediation and retesting. Along with vulnerability management – triage, prioritisation, ownership and risk-based closure and security assurance across design, development, deployment and production support.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Team
  
  
Making an impact. What will you do?
  
  

* The Senior Specialist in this position will lead end-to-end VAPT for web applications, APIs, Android and iOS using manual and automated techniques
* You will also define assessment scope, test strategy, attack scenarios and rules of engagement
* Apply OWASP, CWE, CVSS and relevant NIST guidance throughout assessments
* Validating exploitability, business impact and root cause; eliminate false positives
* You will also quality-assure findings for severity, evidence, reproducibility, remediation and reporting accuracy
* And manage UVM intake and triage – validation, deduplication, ownership, prioritisation and SLA tracking
* Also, assess patch and remediation options – applicability, dependencies, implementation risk and compensating controls
* Provide remediation guidance covering secure code, configuration, dependency upgrades, patching and architectural controls
* Along with performing retesting, residual-risk assessment, verified closure and exception/risk-acceptance support
* Also, maintain evidence, audit traceability, metrics, dashboards and management reporting
* Support threat modelling, security architecture, secure-design and pre-production reviews
* Review and correlate SAST, DAST, SCA and cloud/container security findings
* You will develop reusable testing methodologies, checklists, scripts and automation
* And mentor engineers; lead technical reviews, stakeholder discussions and complex security escalations

Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree – Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering or equivalent
* Preferred certifications – OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GWAPT, GMOB or equivalent hands-on offensive-security credential
* 5+ years – hands-on application security, web/API/mobile VAPT and vulnerability management
* Knowledge on OWASP WSTG, Top 10, API Security Top 10, MASVS/MASTG, CWE and CVSS and Burp Suite Professional, Acunetix, Kali Linux, Nmap, Metasploit and sqlmap is a must

title: Zscaler Engineer (Available to join in 0-30 days)
description:
**Job Description: Zscaler Engineer**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a skilled
**Network Security Engineer**
with a strong focus on
**Zscaler**
technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for managing, configuring, and optimizing our secure cloud transformation and network security infrastructure.
  
  
This is a
**Hybrid**
role. Candidates must be located in or willing to relocate to one of our office hubs.
  
  
**Key Information**

* Total Experience: 5 to 7 years in Network Security
* Zscaler Experience: 2 to 3 years of dedicated, hands-on experience (Mandatory)
* Job Type: Hybrid
* Locations: Pune, Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, Kolkata, Hyderabad
* Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days max

**Key Responsibilities**

* Zscaler Management: Handle the deployment, configuration, policy administration, and troubleshooting of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA).
* Traffic Redirection & Engineering: Manage and maintain Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) deployments, PAC files, and traffic redirection methods (GRE/IPSec tunnels).
* Security Policy Administration: Configure and monitor URL filtering, SSL inspection, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) policies.
* Network Security Operations: Support traditional network security controls including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), intrusion prevention systems (IPS), and secure web gateways.
* Operations & Troubleshooting: Serve as the escalation point for complex network security issues, utilizing packet capture tools (Wireshark) to diagnose connectivity and performance anomalies.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the infrastructure and network teams to ensure smooth integration of Zscaler with SD-WAN and cloud environments (AWS/Azure).

**Required Skills & QualificationsZscaler Expertise (Mandatory)**

* 2–3 years of direct experience with ZIA (Cloud Firewall, Sandbox, Native SSL decryption).
* 2–3 years of direct experience with ZPA (App Connectors, Access Policies, User Portals).
* Proven experience troubleshooting Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) issues on Windows, macOS, or Linux.

**Core Network Security & Networking**

* Production experience with at least one major firewall platform (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point).
* Solid understanding of core routing and switching concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, OSPF, SD-WAN).
* Good grasp of standard authentication protocols (SAML, Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) as they integrate with Zscaler.

**Logistical Requirements**

* Must be available to join immediately or within a 30-day notice period.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA) or Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP).
* Certification in firewall technologies (e.g., PCNSE, NSE 4).
* CCNA/CCNP Security.

**What We Offer**

* Hybrid work flexibility balancing collaborative in-office days with focused remote work.
* Direct exposure to enterprise-scale cloud security migrations.
* Competitive compensation and clear technical career progression.
